senses.gloss: सीमन्त- + उन्नयन सीमन्त- + उन्नयन, n. (arranging of the hair) a purificatory and sacrificial ceremony observed by women in the sixth or eighth month of their first pregnancy.
सीमा- + विवाद सीमा- + विवाद, m. a litigation respecting boundaries, Man. 8, 6.
शिम्बि and वी शिम्बी, f. A legume, a pod, Mālat. 145, 20.
सिम सिम (akin to सम), adj. Every, all, entire.

सीमन् सीमन्, i. e. सि or सिव् + मन्, and सीमा सीमा, f.
 1. A boundary, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 461; a limit, a landmark, Man. 8, 149; 255; Pañc. i. d. 104 (मन् and मा); skirt, Utt. Rāmac. 43, 6 (मन्).
 2. Observance of due bounds in morals, Bhaṭṭ. 1, 6; Nalod. 3, 28.
 3. A field.
 4. The nape of the neck.
 5. The scrotum.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ἵμας; O.S. sîmo, laqueus.

सीमन्त सीमन्त, i. e. *सीमन्त्, the original form of सीमन्, + अ,
 I. m. A separation of the hair on each side, so as to leave a distinct line on the top of the head, Megh. 66.
 II. m. and n. The head.
 III. m. or n. A landmark (?), Lass. 41, 7.
सीमन्तित सीमन्तित, i. e. ptcple. pf. pass. of a denomin. सीमन्तय, derived from सीमन्त, Marked by a line, Kir. 4, 18.
सीमन्तिनी सीमन्तिनी, i. e. सीमन्त + इन् + ई, f. A woman, Hit. ii. d. 6.
